asset_exclude.references/opencode-harness.md: Maintainer documentation for the Claude-side OpenCode execute-tier harness. Records the harness's own Homebrew install path ($(brew --prefix)/opt/agent-safehouse/...) and $HOME-relative git config mounts, which dist/ forbids. It stays accurate for Claude readers in plugins/; the generated dispatch prose points at the harness by name instead of restating it.
asset_exclude.scripts/dispatch-banner.py: Colour-codes the imp roster by Claude model name — `opus`/`sonnet`/`haiku` substring matches against a `model` field in the run state file. This build routes by tier (`cheap`/`standard`/`deep`) and its state file carries no `model` field, so the script would silently colour every imp the default green while re-introducing Claude model names as a runtime choice (contract item 23). Its only caller was the Workflow-driven Phase 3, which this directory's overrides replace with a foreground loop that has no roster to print.
asset_exclude.scripts/final-banner.py: The end-of-run companion to dispatch-banner.py, excluded for the same reason: it colours by `opus`/`sonnet`/`haiku` and synthesizes a roster from a `model_counts` map that a tier-routed run never writes. Excluded with its caller, the Workflow `run_complete` checkpoint.
asset_exclude.scripts/imps-run.workflow.js: The Claude Code Workflow runtime for the whole run — agent() dispatch, isolation: 'worktree', the Workflow resume model. Neither platform has a Workflow tool, so shipping it would present Claude mechanics as if they run there (contract item 16). The per-platform dispatch loop is prose, from this directory's overrides.
asset_exclude.scripts/opencode-dispatch.sh: The Claude-host oracle-loop harness. Copies the operator's own OpenCode auth from a $HOME-relative path and drives sandbox-wrap.sh, so it is unusable without it and cannot satisfy dist/'s no-machine-paths invariant as written. Frozen Claude sources forbid rewriting it here.
asset_exclude.scripts/opencode-review.sh: The Claude-host read-only OpenCode review harness. It copies a provider credential into a temporary XDG tree and uses Claude Workflow wrapper mechanics, neither of which belongs in generated runtimes that already review inside their own runtime.
asset_exclude.scripts/sandbox-smoke.sh: Seatbelt grant-boundary smoke test for sandbox-wrap.sh. Asserts against $HOME-relative paths throughout; excluded with the wrapper it tests.
asset_exclude.scripts/sandbox-wrap.sh: Darwin-only Seatbelt wrapper (agent-safehouse). Resolves the safehouse binary through /opt/homebrew and /usr/local/opt and canonicalises $HOME — absolute machine paths dist/ must never carry, and unfixable here because Claude sources are frozen.
